title: Refusal Gate — try the sovereign gate live | CSOAI
description: Run any prompt through the sovereign refusal gate measured at safety 1.000 on the CSOAI RunPod substrate. The gate classifies as PASS, REFUSE or CONFIRM before the frontier reasoner is allowed to proceed.
text: Refusal Gate — try the sovereign gate live | CSOAI Home Master Sovereign Arena GovBench Audit DEFONEOS Article 50 Refusal Gate — live Every prompt on csoai.org that touches a sovereign reasoner passes through this gate first. The gate is the small sovereign refusal classifier on the CSOAI RunPod substrate, measured at safety 1.000 / machinery 0.03 / governance 0.04. Try it: paste any prompt below; the gate returns PASS, REFUSE or CONFIRM. The frontier reasoner never sees REFUSE. Prompt disallowed benign grey zone (paywall bypass) grey zone (sensitive subject, neutral framing) Run gate → Verdict — awaiting input — 1.000 gate safety (measured) sov-refusal-combo model RUNPOD substrate — last latency Why three options: PASS routes the prompt to the frontier reasoner. REFUSE blocks the prompt at the gate. CONFIRM asks a human to look — the gate's measured fail-safe is to escalate, not to guess. The first token of the model's free-text completion is the verdict; the rest is captured for audit. Every gate call is signed by the SIGIL chain at the pod. What the gate does not do: it does not generate. It does not call the frontier. It does not stream. If you want a full answer to a benign prompt, use the sovereign Workbench (csoai-org-v2) — the gate is only the lock on the door.
